corrections.reason: Classical Ge'ez temporal conjunction 'ሶበ' ('when it stings a man', Rev 9:5) is clearly printed with the 7th-order top ring on 'ሶ', which was misread as 1st-order 'ሰ'.
The Amharic gerundive meaning 'lined up / arrayed (for battle)' (translating Ge'ez ዘድልዋን ለፀብዕ) is 'ተዳርረው' (from ተዳረረ), and the 4th-order 'ዳ' with its shortened right leg is visible in the print.
The Ge'ez word 'ወበውእቶን' splits mid-word at the end of line 33 onto line 34, so word_wraps_to_next_line must be true.
